title: Lord Mithaniel Marr
summary: Defeating Ralthazor opens the confrontation with Lord Mithaniel Marr.
overview: Defeating Ralthazor opens the confrontation with Lord Mithaniel Marr.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Clear the preceding temple encounter with Ralthazor to activate Marr.
Marr’s activation lasts two hours. When that window expires, he returns to his inactive state once no longer engaged.
Defeat Marr and speak with the planar projection that appears for progression credit.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
